purpose: Teach: 後援/図表/台数/ターミナル/コーディネーター/歴代/三井/近況

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 蓮、地域イベント、後援する企業、調べておけ。
lines.en: Ren — research the companies backing the local event.
lines.style: Direct, economical phrasing. Measured tempo. The tone of someone assigning work to someone capable. A single beat of eye contact.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい。論文の図表、できる限り、視覚的に作ります。
lines.en: Yes. I'll make the charts for my paper as visually clear as possible.
lines.style: Attentive and responsive. Slight eagerness underneath. Speaks at moderate pace, careful not to overcommit. Slight nod as confirmation.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 参考文献の台数、十分か、確認しろ。
lines.en: Check that you have enough references — verify the count.
lines.style: Calm, checking-in tone. Not interrogative, more like reviewing a mental checklist together. Steady breath, no urgency.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい。空港ターミナルで、研究調査、実施しました。
lines.en: Yes. I've already conducted research interviews at the airport terminal.
lines.style: Matter-of-fact, almost proud-quiet. Not boasting — just reporting completion. Straightforward delivery, even pacing.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 学会のコーディネーターと、関係、築け。
lines.en: Build a relationship with the conference coordinator.
lines.style: Advice delivered without weight. Brief pause before the clause. The sureness of someone who has built many such relationships himself.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい。歴代の博士論文、図書館で、確認しました。
lines.en: Yes. I've reviewed previous PhD dissertations in the library.
lines.style: Steady affirmation. Slight warmth in having done the work already. Measured delivery, no strain. A small beat at the end, ready for the next task.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 三井財閥の歴史、論文に、参考になるぞ。
lines.en: The Mitsui zaibatsu history will serve your paper well as a reference point.
lines.style: Offering insight as a gift, not a correction. Unhurried pace. Slight warmth — mentoring mode. Settles the information gently.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい。先輩方の近況、ゼミで共有していただいています。
lines.en: Yes. My senior colleagues have been sharing updates in our seminar meetings.
lines.style: Appreciative and grounded. Calm closing. The satisfaction of being held in a community of scholars. Even breath, no trailing-off — a natural end.
